verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE explicitly supports natural-language interaction: users can ask for logs/charts in plain language, tag @betterstack in Slack, or use the MCP server to query telemetry from LLM workflows like Claude Code. This is a genuine natural-language operation surface, not just chat-adjacent automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language query accuracy, and broader coverage beyond logs/charts (e.g., natural-language incident management or monitor configuration).
